title: Soul Feast #60: The Universe Doesn’t Judge
excerpt: Explore your full potential, so you can give the gifts you were born to give.
bodyHtml:
Explore your full potential, so you can give the gifts you were born to give. Your soul has been waiting for you to take this journey!

Learn More Here.

In this transformative episode of The Gary Zukav Deepcast, Gary shares one of the most liberating truths of the Earth School: the universe doesn’t judge. What we perceive as justice or injustice, fairness or unfairness, are human projections rooted in fear. Gary invites listeners to see that every experience – pleasant or painful – is not a punishment or reward but a reflection of our own choices, designed to serve our soul’s growth.

Through stories and profound insights, Gary dismantles the illusion of “right” and “wrong,” showing how judgment fuels suffering and separation. 

Instead of seeking justice through blame, we are called to understand karma as an impartial, non-judgmental teacher that mirrors our intentions back to us. 

From wealth and poverty to oppression and privilege, every circumstance is an opportunity to learn love over fear – nothing more, nothing less.

Ultimately, Gary reminds us that life’s power lies in conscious choice. When we let go of judgment – toward ourselves, others, and the world – we step into authentic power, grounded in gratitude, compassion, and awe. Justice, as the universe knows it, is not moral verdict but divine balance: the continuous unfolding of learning, love, and evolution.

What You’ll Discover in This Episode:

  • (01:13) — Why the universe doesn’t judge — and how this changes the meaning of justice
  • (02:56) — The Earth School as a realm of non-judgmental justice and karmic learning
  • (05:55) — How judgment is born from fear and creates painful consequences
  • (09:02) — Understanding karma as cause and effect — not reward or punishment
  • (12:13) — The power of conscious choice — love vs. fear as the only real options
  • (17:47) — Letting go of “right” and “wrong” to live with gratitude, compassion, and awe
  • (21:12) — A Soul Step reflection exercise to notice and release judgment in daily life

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Take out your Soul Notebook and notice every time you judge – yourself, another person, or a situation. Write it down. Then write each moment when judgment disappeared and you simply saw another soul. Reflect on what those moments reveal about your frightened and loving parts. The next time judgment arises, pause, breathe, and choose love instead. Each choice to stop judging is a lesson in non-judgmental justice – the universe’s only kind.
